Likely fix area confirmed: get_combinator_sql applies set_values() to component queries shared because Query.clone() shallow-copies combined_queries. Reading exact flow before patch.

The component clone in get_combinator_sql itself should prevent set_values mutating originals; likely mutation is elsewhere: get_order_by resolves expressions against self.query and may add select columns through get_extra_select. Tracing pre_sql_setup/get_extra_select and Query.clone sharing combined queries.
